name: generated-workspace-visual-contract
goal: Register visual cases from nested workspaces at the repository registry

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A generated visual unit in a nested app workspace lacks registration at the repository registry.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing generator cases cover project-root components and routes only; they do not check monorepo registry ownership, test paths, scenario working directory, or build identity.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The existing generator case fails at 41822ff57b on harbor-mbp-2 because portal.component.workspace-card lacks its contract. Harness record b93a4c173fef4ff8959085d23fcd8edd1ed9d7246a67f5e45e52c2c35e0e32eb.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit 23d96efe42 registers nested visual cases at the repository registry and selects their workspace build.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Harness record 2248893c5eeb39b4de6e12f1d210e5639cfb81f4196246e135c179ab09d58a40 passed the unchanged case at 23d96efe42 on harbor-mbp-2 with the red profile.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
